_note: Install tutorial shown when the user clicks 'Get this app'. Same slides for every app. Images live under src/img/tutorial/. Captions are localized. On the last slide the 'Next' button turns into a CTA that opens CasaOS at runtime.casaosUrl (from CASAOS_URL env).

caption.en: Open your dashboard and click **App Store**.
caption.fr: Ouvrez votre tableau de bord et cliquez sur **App Store**.

caption.en: Browse the featured apps, or scroll down to see the full catalogue.
caption.fr: Parcourez les apps mises en avant, ou faites défiler pour tout voir.
caption.ko: 추천 앱을 살펴보거나 아래로 스크롤해 전체 목록을 확인하세요.

caption.en: Search for the app you want and click **Install**.
caption.fr: Recherchez l'app souhaitée et cliquez sur **Installer**.

caption.en: Confirm to start the install — you can continue using your dashboard while it runs.
caption.fr: Confirmez pour lancer l'installation — vous pouvez continuer à utiliser votre tableau de bord pendant ce temps.
caption.ko: 설치를 시작하려면 확인하세요. 설치가 진행되는 동안에도 대시보드를 계속 사용할 수 있어요.

caption.en: The install keeps running in the background — you can watch the progress right on the dashboard.
caption.fr: L'installation continue en arrière-plan — suivez la progression directement sur le tableau de bord.
caption.ko: 설치는 백그라운드에서 계속 진행되며, 대시보드에서 바로 진행 상황을 확인할 수 있어요.

caption.en: Once it's ready, the app appears on your dashboard — click it to launch.
caption.fr: Une fois prête, l'app apparaît sur votre tableau de bord — cliquez pour la lancer.
caption.ko: 설치가 완료되면 앱이 대시보드에 나타나요. 클릭해서 실행하세요.
